articles.title: U.S. Senate unanimously opposes clemency for FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried
articles.snippet: The nonbinding resolution passed without objection after Bankman-Fried asked for clemency, months after Trump pardoned other major crypto figures, including Changpeng Zhao and Ross Ulbricht.

articles.title: US Senate unanimously adopts resolution opposing clemency for SBF
articles.snippet: The Senate approved a resolution opposing clemency for former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried as prediction markets put the odds of a Trump pardon by July 31 below 1%.

articles.title: Trump to meet with senators over CLARITY Act on Thursday: Politico
articles.snippet: US President Donald Trump is set to meet with several senators on Thursday as negotiators race to get the CLARITY Act across the line before the Senate’s August recess.

articles.title: Stanford study says 5-minute Bitcoin prediction markets enable settlement manipulation
articles.snippet: Researchers found that Polymarket’s five-minute Bitcoin prediction markets create incentives to manipulate spot prices around contract settlement, proposing longer settlement windows as a potential fix.

articles.title: US senator blasts AG pick for ‘dismantling’ crypto unit, Trump’s CZ pardon
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump’s pick for attorney general faced criticism from members of the Senate Judiciary Committee on his approach to crypto enforcement and the pardon of former Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao.
